parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The file system type.

Valid values:

- standard: General-purpose NAS
- extreme: Extreme NAS
- all (default): all types.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the file system list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of file systems on each page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.
